title: Public lobby and preset emotes and reactions (online)
problem: Players cannot see or browse open games with real players, and cannot react to each other; quick match hides who is waiting.
scope: Public or Private when creating a room; a public room list (host name, seats, game length, wait) kept by a list server like quick match, refreshed every few seconds
The host may start with computers in empty seats after a wait (proposed 60 s)
Eight preset reactions (emoji and short lines; no fruit, numbers or free text), shown as a bubble over the stall; one per 2 s per player; mute a player; a Settings switch hides all
Protocol 5; older phones asked to update; privacy page and anonymous counters (counts only)
Room-server, list-server and leak tests; a two-browser e2e test; screens at 390, 360 and 320

acceptance.text: npm run verify with the new room and list tests
acceptance.evidence: npm run verify on the merged branch (d0cc64b): 95 test files, 1045 passed, 1 skipped (as before); new tests in tests/room.test.ts (12), tests/lobby.test.ts (6), tests/public-lobby.test.ts (9)

acceptance.text: npm run test:e2e with the two-browser public room and reactions test, 0 leaks
acceptance.evidence: PORT=8815 npm run test:e2e on the merged branch: E2E OK. Solo game finished, 0 secret-price leaks in 78 frames; public room and reactions 4/4 reaction frames, 0 leaks; quick match, four players with computers, 5 reconnects OK. The speed check failed its first try (230 ms long task, noisy on this machine) and passed on the script's retry

Screens at 390x844, 360x640 and 320x568 on a local room server: Public rooms list empty and with rooms, Public or Private, lobby countdown and "Start with N computers", reaction picker, bubbles in the lobby and game, mute and unmute, Settings "Show reactions", reduced motion

acceptance.text: A 1.25.0 phone against the new server is asked to update and nothing breaks
acceptance.evidence: Against the new server a protocol-4 hello (as a 1.25.0 phone sends) gets the existing update message and later messages are refused (room test and a raw socket check; not an installed 1.25.0 build). A room made the 1.25.0 way is private and never listed

acceptance.text: The owner on the preview with a second phone

approval.evidence: Owner, 2026-11-20: "approve plan 112, use your picks" (spectating later; emoji plus preset lines; start with computers after 60 s)

added: Public or Private when starting an online game; a Public rooms list on the online screen (host, seats taken of 6, game length, minutes waiting, Join), read every 5 s; a list server (LobbyDO) and GET /api/public
After a room has waited 60 s, its host may start with computers in every empty seat, even alone
12 preset reactions (8 emoji and Good luck, Nice sale, Oops, Well played): a bubble over the seat for 3 s, one every 2 s per player, mute a player in the room, a Settings switch "Show reactions"
Anonymous counters: public room opened, joined from the list, started with computers, reaction sent
A two-browser e2e test for a public room and reactions
changed: Online protocol 5: phones on 1.25.0 are asked to update before going online (rules version stays 20, AI 7)
Privacy page: a public room shows its host's name, seats, game length and waiting time to people looking for a game

playerNotes: Online: start a public room and anyone can find it in the new Public rooms list and join
Online: after a minute of waiting, the host can fill the empty seats with computers and start
Online: send a reaction to the room, 8 emoji and 4 short lines; mute a player, or turn reactions off in Settings
